input.quote: Commerce One warrants that the Software and MarketSite.net Service will perform in substantial accordance with the Documentation, and the media on which the Software is distributed will be free from defects in materials and workmanship under normal use, for a period of sixty (60) days from the Effective Date, but in no event not later than December 31, 1999 (the "Warranty Period").
input.rationale: Section 7.3 does contain a real express conformance warranty (Documentation conformance, media, no malicious code) and Section 7.3/7.4 plus the remedy paragraph give correction, replacement and, where breach cannot be corrected, termination with a refund of prepaid fees — so the remedy limb meets the playbook and the disclaimer (p0084) does not swallow the express warranties. The failure is duration: the Warranty Period is only sixty (60) days from the Effective Date and is hard-capped at December 31, 1999, whereas Acceptance Testing under Section 3.1 may itself run to December 31, 1999. The warranty can therefore expire on or before acceptance, falling below the fallback of ninety (90) days for software. We propose extending the period to twelve (12) months from acceptance (preferred), flagging ninety (90) days from acceptance as an acceptable fallback; the remedy and exclusions are left untouched.

ops.oldText: for a period of sixty (60) days from the Effective Date, but in no event not later than December 31, 1999 (the "Warranty Period")
ops.newText: for a period of twelve (12) months from the date of Corio's acceptance of the Software pursuant to Section 3.1 (the "Warranty Period")

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We extended the Warranty Period to twelve (12) months running from acceptance rather than sixty (60) days from the Effective Date with a fixed December 31, 1999 cut-off, since a period that can expire before or shortly after acceptance testing leaves us without a conformance warranty. Our playbook position is 12 months for software; we can accept ninety (90) days from acceptance as a fallback, and the existing correct/replace/refund remedy is unchanged.
proposal.summary: Extend the Product Warranty Period from 60 days from the Effective Date (hard-capped at 31 Dec 1999) to 12 months from acceptance of the Software.
